hypothesis: Untried rung: profile-guided optimization. The workload is branchy and dispatch-heavy (EVM opcode dispatch, MDBX B-tree comparisons, jsonrpsee routing), the kind of code where PGO's block layout and inlining decisions pay off. build-pgo.sh instruments, trains on the same light+heavy eth_call mix, merges the profiles and rebuilds with -Cprofile-use, keeping the family's target-cpu in both passes. Expect 3-10%.
llm_commentary: Bracket run for the THP delta: PGO without THP reproduces at 4.46s [4.47/4.44/4.46] against its first measurement of 4.43s [4.45/4.41/4.42], so PGO is stable to ~0.03s across two independent builds an hour apart, and the THP+PGO result of 4.31s [4.29/4.33/4.32] sits clearly below both with no range overlap. That makes THP worth -2.7% to -3.4% on top of PGO on Graviton5. Both of tonight's wins are now bracketed the same way: control 4.72 / 4.71 around PGO, and PGO 4.43 / 4.46 around THP+PGO. Stack so far on m9g: 4.72 -> 4.43 (PGO) -> 4.31 (THP), i.e. -8.7% for the round.
